code:
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> Unconfigured
    Unconfigured --> Configuring : configure()
    Configuring --> Inactive : on_configure() 成功
    Inactive --> Activating : activate()
    Activating --> Active : on_activate() 成功
    Active --> Deactivating : deactivate()
    Deactivating --> Inactive : on_deactivate() 成功
    Inactive --> Cleaningup : cleanup()
    Cleaningup --> Unconfigured : on_cleanup() 成功
    Active --> Error : 错误
    Inactive --> Error : 错误
    Error --> Unconfigured : 重新配置
